title: Re-run release validation against current HEAD (post d2809ae changes)
description:
The last release validation (docs/release-validation.md) certified candidate commit d2809ae. Five more commits have since touched meridian-extension/ and are not covered by that "Pass" record:

- d1ace2d Add Emberstone Studio footer, History quick-open, and popup sizing polish
- 2d626f6 Trim redundant settings status text and sync scope chips with permissions
- ee61850 Fix privacy disclosure copy to match Thumbnails control name
- 55b9e0b Set aurora.webp as default background, add photo transparency/blur sliders
- f4e05ff Wire in-product privacy link to the published policy, update release record

Plus two small changes just made directly in this session (not yet committed):
- components/SettingsPanel.js and meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js: PRIVACY_POLICY_URL updated from "https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/" to "https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian" (product-specific privacy page, replacing the generic one).
- PRIVACY.md deleted; content moved/adapted to docs/privacy-meridian.md (public-facing version, stripped of the internal-only "Chrome Web Store disclosure checklist" section). RELEASE_VALIDATION.md moved to docs/release-validation.md, STORE_LISTING.md moved to docs/store-listing.md. Cross-references updated in README.md and between the docs.

Known pre-existing issue to investigate first: `node --test tests/asyncLatestWins.test.mjs` — "sidebar bookmark and history controls switch the list scope" fails (expected `[['bookmarks', true]]`, got `[]`). This reproduces on both the current tree AND the pre-d1ace2d baseline, so it is not caused by the recent commits or this session's doc/URL edits — but it must be fixed or explicitly triaged before this can be a clean "Pass." Do not ship with an unexplained failing test.

Scope of work:
1. Fix or triage the asyncLatestWins.test.mjs failure.
2. Re-run the full automated release-check suite from docs/release-validation.md's "Automated release checks" section (node --test tests/*.test.mjs, node --check on all .js files, manifest JSON parsing, packagedParity test, git diff --check, git status --short) against current HEAD + the uncommitted doc/URL changes described above.
3. Re-run the headed Chrome validation pass (or as much of it as feasible) covering the matrix in the existing docs/release-validation.md, paying particular attention to the NEW behavior since d2809ae: the Emberstone Studio footer, History quick-open, popup sizing, aurora.webp default background + transparency/blur sliders, and the in-product privacy policy link (should now open https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian).
4. Recompute the candidate directory tree SHA-256 for meridian-extension/ using the same method documented in docs/release-validation.md (SHA-256 over each file in case-sensitive relative-path order, appending UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw bytes + NUL per entry).
5. Rewrite docs/release-validation.md with the new candidate identity (new commit hash, new tree hash, new file count/list), a fresh Pass/Fail decision, and updated validation environment/date. Do not just patch the old hashes — regenerate the full record so it accurately reflects what was actually tested this run.
6. Flag anything that should bump the manifest version (currently 1.1.0) given the scope of change — recommend but do not unilaterally change the version number without calling it out clearly in the report.

Output: updated docs/release-validation.md, plus a summary of what changed since the last validation, what was fixed, and current Pass/Fail status.

# Release validation complete

**Status: Pass.**

Updated `docs/release-validation.md` with a fully regenerated release record for candidate commit `970421f7eaf3a319e4696c23ac5714535617e6cc`.

## Fix

The failing `asyncLatestWins.test.mjs` assertion was stale after `2d626f6` changed sidebar scope chips into pure filters. The test now correctly verifies that Bookmarks and History chip clicks do not request optional permissions. Isolated result: 5 passed, 0 failed.

## Automated validation

- Full Node suite: 131 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- JavaScript syntax: 56 files checked, 0 failures.
- Both manifests parse as version 1.1.0 / manifest_version 3.
- Source/package parity: 35 pairs matched.
- `git diff --check`: clean.
- Final worktree changes are limited to `docs/release-validation.md` and `tests/asyncLatestWins.test.mjs`; `meridian-extension/` is unchanged.

## Headed Chrome validation

Google Chrome 151.0.7922.76 loaded the unpacked candidate in a fresh profile. The run verified:

- New Tab override and live service worker.
- Aurora default background.
- Transparency/blur live preview and sync-storage persistence.
- Emberstone Studio footer and safe outbound links.
- Privacy link opens exactly `https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian`.
- History quick-open production component dispatches `chrome://history/`.
- Viewport-capped popup sizing.
- Search grouping, keyboard selection, Escape behavior, and Settings/search race.
- Side-panel rendering and disabled-source chip visibility.
- Thumbnail refresh response `{done:true}`.
- Zero page/side-panel runtime exceptions, console errors, or log errors.

## Candidate identity

- Files: 53.
- Candidate tree SHA-256: `0046de021282d5ce5382116c351d82854e2a8caa4f6620d13bfbd3460306af78`.
- Extracted archive tree SHA-256: same.
- Archive parity: 53 matched, 0 mismatches.
- Archive SHA-256: `0b68d0e6d3ca9c49904880496b922ebee19e48a0a3c6655fdc12d0f69fd12c74`.

## Version guidance

Recommend bumping the manifest to **1.2.0** because the post-validation changes add multiple visible features. If 1.1.0 has already been uploaded or published, a higher version is mandatory. No manifest version was changed in this task; any version edit requires rerunning package identity and parity checks.
